integrity: Proof uses exact matching probabilities, a nonnegative-support obstruction and a proved integral polynomial recurrence. A standalone exact-arithmetic checker corroborates finite cases; computation is not substituted for the infinite argument.
scientific_limitations: Uniform complete-graph perfect matchings and indicators of one fixed perfect matching only; no weighted or nonuniform matching generalization. Historical priority outside inspected sources is not independently certified.
title: The exact four-coordinate exchangeability reserve of a uniform perfect matching
